Matched experience 6fcd6376641fabd68811e2b973e73444b5f602f80ab32d029097d93133147320
6fcd6376641fabd68811e2b973e73444b5f602f80ab32d029097d93133147320:R01 [Applicability]
Apply when a reusable progress source serves distinct visits and attempts, startup can emit synchronously, decoding can finish later, and retained audit differs from visible presentation. README.md: "The same file and source can be reused\nby multiple panel visits. Each selected or retried attempt starts one subscription." Confirm these premises in each target system.

6fcd6376641fabd68811e2b973e73444b5f602f80ab32d029097d93133147320:R02 [Event relation]
Register reception before starting the source, preserving subsequent streaming and public interfaces. Original src/workflow.py invokes "        env.call('start',file['token'])\n        subscription=env.call('listen',file['token'],callback)". README.md states: "Starting a view of the stream may synchronously\nemit its cached progress event; further progress events arrive on the same target."

Check originating subscription and visit eligibility before decoding each packet. Retirement immediately prevents subsequent admission, including additional packets emitted before startup returns; do not depend solely on physical listener removal. README.md: "A retired visit\naccepts no new progress events."

6fcd6376641fabd68811e2b973e73444b5f602f80ab32d029097d93133147320:R03 [Preservation]
Separate admission, retained audit and visible publication. Record each admitted event exactly once when decoding completes, including after retirement or disposal; check originating visit validity before visible publication. README.md: "Every accepted progress event is recorded exactly once when decoding\nfinishes, including work accepted before the visit closes." It also states: "Removing a listener does not retract a decode\nthat already started. Closing or replacing the visit stops visible progress;\nnew visits remain live." Reopening the identical file creates a distinct visit.

Coordinate cleanup and ownership across callback-capable startup and cancellation. Retire old ownership before cleanup can reenter navigation; when an older operation resumes, prevent it from overwriting newer ownership and clean up its retired resources. Preserve idempotent cancellation and disposal. README.md: "Selection and hiding may themselves cancel an old handle and synchronously\nreceive newer navigation; the newer navigation keeps ownership." Also: "Disposal removes subscriptions and cancels transfers; work already accepted\nfor audit remains retained." A provisional cleanup handle is an implementation option, not a mandated public interface.

Keep accepted retries bound to their entry file and visit. Cancel the prior transfer before enqueueing, preserve exactly one accepted command and record across cancellation navigation, cancel the resulting transfer if its visit ended, and suppress retired queued notices. README.md: "The accepted old retry must still enqueue and record once after such navigation.\nIts newly created transfer is canceled immediately if its visit has ended; this\ndoes not remove its retained queue record." Also: "Queued notices are visible output: a notice\nfrom a retired visit must not be sent, including after reopening the same file." Preserve independent workspace counters and cancellation.

6fcd6376641fabd68811e2b973e73444b5f602f80ab32d029097d93133147320:R04 [Exclusion]
Keep the repair within reception and necessary lifecycle coordination. Preserve queue and notice shapes and adapter interfaces. README.md: "Every queue record remains exactly `{fileId, attemptId, visitId, kind}`;" and "Notices remain\n`{fileId, attemptId, visitId, status: \"queued\"}`." Do not introduce decode freshness suppression without a target-specific requirement: VISIBLE_CHECKS.md states, "These maintenance examples do not impose composition-specific out-of-order display rules." Do not transfer unrelated diagnostic-consumer policies into this repair.

Candidate limitations:
- Evidence is the supplied original TASK and public documents/code; automatic contracts, experience text and evaluation observations do not establish requirements.
- TASK: "Restore the initial update while preserving the existing transfer, retry, navigation, cleanup and audit behavior, ordinary streaming and subsequent uses. The queue-record format is outside this fix."
- VISIBLE_CHECKS.md: "These maintenance examples do not impose composition-specific out-of-order display rules." No arrival-order suppression or numeric monotonicity requirement is established.
- Decoder failures, adapter exceptions and visibility of already accepted decoding from a canceled attempt whose visit remains current are unspecified.
- Attempt 1 supports the reflection context but its passing examples do not establish complete correctness, causality or cross-task benefit. No implementation failure is established.
- Diagnostic-consumer requirements from other experiences are not established for this public source. No files were modified.

6fcd6376641fabd68811e2b973e73444b5f602f80ab32d029097d93133147320:R05 [Verification]
Verify cached startup and later streaming, immediate and deferred decoding, retained audit after hide/disposal, and new delivery after same-file reopening. Exercise synchronous hide, switch and reopening during startup, with subsequent packets before the outer startup returns: retired listeners must reject new admission while previously admitted decoding retains audit. Separately verify newer ownership after cancellation reentry, accepted entry-bound retry recording and cancellation, current queued notices, repeated cleanup, workspace independence and unchanged record shapes. These checkpoints follow README.md's documented lifecycle; they do not prescribe an order among independently completing decodes.


Matched experience fa1cce3815656f804a1e442547ec3c3fad4b5f74858c5fe63f19083a31c27a78
fa1cce3815656f804a1e442547ec3c3fad4b5f74858c5fe63f19083a31c27a78:R01 [Applicability]
Apply when a shared progress source serves distinct visits and attempts, startup can emit synchronously, full-frame decoding may finish later, and history and presentation have different lifetimes. README.md: "Selecting a file creates a visit. Retry replaces the physical attempt without\nopening another visit. Selecting the same file object again opens a new visit." README.md: "The source is shared by attempts and visits for that file. start may emit cached\npackets synchronously; decoding yields a full frame, immediately or later.\nDecode completion order can differ from packet arrival order." Confirm these premises and the target's display-order requirement before applying freshness suppression.

fa1cce3815656f804a1e442547ec3c3fad4b5f74858c5fe63f19083a31c27a78:R02 [Event relation]
Register panel reception before invoking startup, preserving later streaming. Original src/workflow.go: "env.Call(\"start\",file.Token);subscription=env.Call(\"listen\",file.Token,callback)". TASK: "Restore the initial progress update without changing the public\ntransfer, retry, navigation, cleanup, audit, or queue-record behavior." Make retirement effective during startup so subsequent packets cannot start new work through an obsolete subscription, even before the outer startup returns. Keep already admitted decoding separate from that admission decision.

fa1cce3815656f804a1e442547ec3c3fad4b5f74858c5fe63f19083a31c27a78:R03 [Event relation]
When the task requires full-frame freshness, assign ordering at packet reception before decoding or callback-capable work. Scope ordering to the display owner, including attempts sharing one visit. After a newer frame has been published, suppress older frames only from presentation. Recheck both visit authority and publication order after audit callbacks; commit the publication watermark before calling the display sink, which may reenter delivery. TASK: "Full\nprogress frames may decode out of order; do not allow an older frame to roll the\ncurrent display backward." README.md: "A full frame replaces displayed state; loaded values can decrease or reset." Reception order, rather than loaded magnitude or completion order, determines freshness. Buffering every result until arrival order can be reconstructed is not required.

fa1cce3815656f804a1e442547ec3c3fad4b5f74858c5fe63f19083a31c27a78:R04 [Preservation]
Keep audit completion independent of display permission. Capture the originating file, attempt and visit; retain the existing audit effect for each admitted decode, including completion after hide, replacement, cancellation or disposal. Audit before deciding whether to paint, then recheck visit authority and freshness because audit may synchronously navigate or complete another decode. README.md: "recordProgress appends transfer history; showProgress paints the open panel." Original src/workflow.go: "deliver:=func(frame interface{}){;audit(frame);view(frame,order)}". A stale display frame still retains its history effect.

fa1cce3815656f804a1e442547ec3c3fad4b5f74858c5fe63f19083a31c27a78:R05 [Preservation]
Coordinate ownership across callback-capable startup and cleanup. Publish cleanup ownership before startup callbacks can navigate; reconcile the returned handle without overwriting resources installed by newer navigation. Remove old resources from current ownership before canceling them, and recheck the navigation request after cleanup returns. Cancel captured retired resources and preserve repeated cleanup behavior. README.md: "One startup window is relevant to this maintenance request: start may emit\nmore than one packet synchronously. A showProgress callback may select or hide\nanother visit before start returns, while its caller has not yet received the\nreturned cleanup handle." README.md: "Removing a listener commits removal before calling the host detach callback;\nthat callback may synchronously select, hide or dispose. Repeated removal is\ninert. Host callbacks execute synchronously unless explicitly deferred." Preserve cancellation order from src/workflow.go: "h.CancelContext();h.Stop();h.Env.Call(\"cancel\",h.File.Token,h.Number)". A provisional handle is an implementation option, not a required public API.

fa1cce3815656f804a1e442547ec3c3fad4b5f74858c5fe63f19083a31c27a78:R06 [Preservation]
Keep an accepted retry bound to its entry visit and file across cancellation reentry. Cancel the previous attempt before enqueueing, retain the accepted command's record and attempt creation, cancel its resulting attempt if its visit has ended, and publish its queued notice only while that visit remains current. Original src/workflow.go: "v.Handle.Cancel();accepted:=v;h:=s.enqueue(accepted,\"retry\");if s.current(accepted){accepted.Handle=h}else{h.Cancel()};if s.current(accepted){s.notice(accepted,h)}". Preserve record-before-transport ordering, independent session counters and disposal. Preserve the exact queue fields from src/workflow.go: "entry:=map[string]interface{}{\"fileId\":v.File.ID,\"attemptId\":n,\"visitId\":v.ID,\"kind\":kind}" and notice fields: "map[string]interface{}{\"fileId\":v.File.ID,\"attemptId\":h.Number,\"visitId\":v.ID,\"status\":\"queued\"}".

fa1cce3815656f804a1e442547ec3c3fad4b5f74858c5fe63f19083a31c27a78:R07 [Exclusion]
Do not generalize panel reception or freshness changes to diagnostic consumers, introduce numeric monotonicity, extend queue records, or discard required audit. README.md: "The same source service also has a diagnostic consumer, Telemetry/\ncollectProgressTelemetry, whose existing live delta observations are separate\nfrom the panel. Keep its existing behavior during this maintenance." README.md: "Queue records are {fileId, attemptId, visitId, kind}\nunless a separate authorization adds byteCount from file.size." Conversely, do not transfer an earlier task's absence of out-of-order display requirements into a target whose TASK explicitly requires freshness protection.

fa1cce3815656f804a1e442547ec3c3fad4b5f74858c5fe63f19083a31c27a78:R08 [Verification]
Check cached startup and later streaming; immediate and deferred decoding; newer-then-older completion with both audit effects retained; and later packets whose loaded values decrease. Exercise nested delivery from audit and display callbacks to verify authority checks and watermark commitment. Navigate during startup, emit another packet before startup returns, and verify retired admission, cleanup, newer ownership and subsequent delivery. Complete admitted decoding after hide, replacement and disposal; reopen the identical file as a new visit. Exercise navigation from unlisten and cancellation, accepted entry-bound retries, retired queued-notice suppression, repeated cleanup, independent sessions, unchanged payloads and unchanged telemetry. These checks follow TASK's preservation and freshness requirements and README.md's synchronous callback model. VISIBLE_CHECKS.md: "These checks are required after an Action but do not test business behavior."
